# Three.js 0.185.1

Source package https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.185.1.tgz

`three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js` and `LICENSE` are copied byte-for-byte from the official npm package. The module imports the adjacent core file. Both JavaScript files are required when serving this directory.

Used by `web/biology-cell-3d.js` for the local cutaway cell models. Loaded on demand when a generated cell experiment uses the 3D view. License MIT, see `LICENSE`.
